provenance: Host-authored direct program with constructor/source review, source restrictions and execution verification.

draft_notes.author: host
draft_notes.explanation: Read the colours in order from the header, preserve the separator, then paint two complete repetitions of the colour sequence into successive bands. Header traversal and band-writing direction are specialized for each D4 using explicit visible indices. Output never normalizes or untransforms a grid.

draft_notes.limitations: Native height is2*n+2 and width n. Native colours exclude0and5, are distinct, and n is2..6; episode palette changes all roles consistently.
